# Radico Khaitan Ltd ($RADICO) — Quick Research Brief

*As of close 9 Jul 2026 · NSE · INR · Source: NSE direct, Yahoo Finance, exchange filings*

---

## Price & Market Data

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Last price** | ₹4,089 (+0.28% on the day) |
| **Market cap** | ₹54,785 crore (~$6.5 bn) |
| **52-week range** | ₹2,500 – ₹4,162 |
| **52-week change** | +51.1% |
| **Drawdown from 52w high** | ~1.7% (near highs) |
| **Beta** | 0.24 (very low vs market) |
| **Shares outstanding** | ~13.40 crore |

The stock has been a strong performer, nearly doubling off its 52-week low and sitting just shy of its all-time high. Low beta suggests it has moved more on company-specific drivers than broad-market beta.

---

## Valuation Snapshot

| Metric | Value | Read |
|---|---|---|
| **P/E (TTM)** | 90.3 | Rich on trailing earnings |
| **Forward P/E** | 56.6 | Market is pricing in sharp earnings growth |
| **P/B** | 16.5 | Well above sector average |
| **EV/EBITDA** | 40.3 | Premium to spirits peers |
| **P/S** | 9.4 | Elevated |
| **EPS (TTM)** | ₹45.26 |

**Interpretation:** On every standard yardstick — trailing P/E, forward P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/B — Radico trades at a **significant premium to most Indian spirits peers**. The forward P/E of ~57 (vs ~90 trailing) signals that the Street expects earnings to expand materially. Whether that compression is justified hinges entirely on sustaining the current growth trajectory.

---

## Profitability & Balance Sheet

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Gross margin** | 43.4% |
| **Operating margin** | 14.9% |
| **Net profit margin** | 8.8% |
| **Revenue (TTM)** | ₹5,851 crore |
| **Net income (TTM)** | ₹517 crore |
| **Debt-to-equity** | 0.21 |
| **Book value / share** | ₹247.8 |

Margins are healthy for the Indian alcobev sector but leave room for operating leverage upside if premiumisation continues. The balance sheet is conservatively geared (D/E ~0.21), giving flexibility for brand/CapEx investment.

---

## Growth (MRQ YoY)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Revenue growth** | +19.5% |
| **Earnings growth** | +62.1% |

Earnings are growing >3× revenue — a clear sign of **operating leverage and mix improvement** (premium brands scaling faster than the base). The key question for the premium valuation: can 20%+ revenue growth and 50%+ earnings growth persist?

---

## Dividend

- **Dividend per share (TTM):** ₹4.0
- **Indicative yield:** ~0.1–0.15% (the provider yield and DPS/price derived yield diverge by >25%; treat as a token yield, not an income name)
- **Latest filing (9 Jul 2026):** Newspaper publication of the 42nd AGM notice, including **record date and dividend** — confirming a dividend has been declared for the AGM. [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/RADICO_09072026130207_intimation092026.pdf)
- **22 Jun 2026:** TDS-on-dividend intimation to shareholders.

Radico is firmly a **growth story, not an income play** — the dividend is symbolic.

---

## Ownership

| Holder | Stake |
|---|---|
| Insiders / promoters | 44.2% |
| Institutions | 29.6% |

Promoter holding is stable and meaningful; institutional ownership at ~30% indicates active coverage but isn't so high as to cap re-rating from incremental flows.

---

## Latest Quarter & Operational Signals

- **Trading window closed 24 Jun 2026** — confirms **Q1 FY27 results are pending** and likely imminent (typical pattern: window reopens a day or two after the results). No Q1 FY27 financial print yet as of 9 Jul.
- **5 Jul 2026 — Operational highlight:** Radico announced that flagship brand **Magic Moments vodka sold 3.25 million cases in Q1 FY27**, a new benchmark for Indian vodka. This is a direct read on volume momentum for the highest-margin part of the portfolio. [NSE press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/RADICO_05072026120308_PressRelease05072026.pdf)
- **No Q4 FY26 financial results surfaced** via web search or filings feed in this pass — the most recent material financial print in the structured data is the TTM summary. The growth metrics above (revenue +19.5%, earnings +62.1%) are MRQ YoY from the data provider and likely reflect the **March 2026 quarter (Q4 FY26)** or the latest available filing.

> ⚠️ *Note: Web search returned no citations this run, and SEC filings are not applicable (Indian listing). The quarterly figures above are from the structured data provider's most-recent-quarter snapshot, not from a verified earnings press release. Treat the exact Q4 FY26 print as unverified — check the company's investor relations page or the NSE/BSE announcement archive for the audited standalone/consolidated numbers.*

---

## SWOT-Style Take

**Strengths**
- Premium brand portfolio (Magic Moments, Royal Ranthambore, Rampur single malts) riding India's premiumisation wave
- Strong earnings growth (+62% YoY) with operating leverage visible
- Conservative balance sheet (D/E 0.21)

**Risks**
- Valuation leaves no margin of safety — P/E 90 / FwdPE 57 assumes flawless execution
- Low-margin IMFL segment still anchors volumes; any excise/regulatory shock hits the whole stack
- Token dividend (yield ~0.1%) means no income cushion if the thesis de-rates
- Geopolitical/macro risk (oil, rates) can compress consumer discretionary multiples even if fundamentals hold

---

## Verdict (One-Liner)

Radico Khaitan is **a high-quality premiumisation compounder priced for near-perfection** — the growth is real (vodka volumes, +62% earnings), but the stock is discounting a lot of the future already. A pullback toward the ₹3,000–3,500 zone would be the risk-reward window; at ₹4,089 near all-time highs, the setup favours momentum traders over value buyers.

---

*As of close 9 Jul 2026 · NSE · INR · Source: NSE direct, Yahoo Finance, exchange filings*

---

The stock has been a strong performer, nearly doubling off its 52-week low and sitting just shy of its all-time high. Low beta suggests it has moved more on company-specific drivers than broad-market beta.

---

## Valuation Snapshot

| Metric | Value | Read |
|---|---|---|
| **P/E (TTM)** | 90.3 | Rich on trailing earnings |
| **Forward P/E** | 56.6 | Market is pricing in sharp earnings growth |

| **EV/EBITDA** | 40.3 | Premium to spirits peers |
| **P/S** | 9.4 | Elevated |
| **EPS (TTM)** | ₹45.26 |

**Interpretation:** On every standard yardstick — trailing P/E, forward P/E, EV/EBITDA, P/B — Radico trades at a **significant premium to most Indian spirits peers**. The forward P/E of ~57 (vs ~90 trailing) signals that the Street expects earnings to expand materially. Whether that compression is justified hinges entirely on sustaining the current growth trajectory.

---

## Profitability & Balance Sheet

| Metric | Value |

| **Book value / share** | ₹247.8 |

Margins are healthy for the Indian alcobev sector but leave room for operating leverage upside if premiumisation continues. The balance sheet is conservatively geared (D/E ~0.21), giving flexibility for brand/CapEx investment.

---

## Growth (MRQ YoY)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| **Revenue growth** | +19.5% |
| **Earnings growth** | +62.1% |

Earnings are growing >3× revenue — a clear sign of **operating leverage and mix improvement** (premium brands scaling faster than the base). The key question for the premium valuation: can 20%+ revenue growth and 50%+ earnings growth persist?

---

## Dividend

- **Dividend per share (TTM):** ₹4.0
- **Indicative yield:** ~0.1–0.15% (the provider yield and DPS/price derived yield diverge by >25%; treat as a token yield, not an income name)
- **Latest filing (9 Jul 2026):** Newspaper publication of the 42nd AGM notice, including **record date and dividend** — confirming a dividend has been declared for the AGM. [NSE filing](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/RADICO_09072026130207_intimation092026.pdf)
- **22 Jun 2026:** TDS-on-dividend intimation to shareholders.

Radico is firmly a **growth story, not an income play** — the dividend is symbolic.

---

## Ownership

| Holder | Stake |
|---|---|
| Insiders / promoters | 44.2% |
| Institutions | 29.6% |

Promoter holding is stable and meaningful; institutional ownership at ~30% indicates active coverage but isn't so high as to cap re-rating from incremental flows.

---

## Latest Quarter & Operational Signals

- **Trading window closed 24 Jun 2026** — confirms **Q1 FY27 results are pending** and likely imminent (typical pattern: window reopens a day or two after the results). No Q1 FY27 financial print yet as of 9 Jul.
- **5 Jul 2026 — Operational highlight:** Radico announced that flagship brand **Magic Moments vodka sold 3.25 million cases in Q1 FY27**, a new benchmark for Indian vodka. This is a direct read on volume momentum for the highest-margin part of the portfolio. [NSE press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/RADICO_05072026120308_PressRelease05072026.pdf)
- **No Q4 FY26 financial results surfaced** via web search or filings feed in this pass — the most recent material financial print in the structured data is the TTM summary. The growth metrics above (revenue +19.5%, earnings +62.1%) are MRQ YoY from the data provider and likely reflect the **March 2026 quarter (Q4 FY26)** or the latest available filing.

> ⚠️ *Note: Web search returned no citations this run, and SEC filings are not applicable (Indian listing). The quarterly figures above are from the structured data provider's most-recent-quarter snapshot, not from a verified earnings press release. Treat the exact Q4 FY26 print as unverified — check the company's investor relations page or the NSE/BSE announcement archive for the audited standalone/consolidated numbers.*

---

## SWOT-Style Take

**Strengths**
- Premium brand portfolio (Magic Moments, Royal Ranthambore, Rampur single malts) riding India's premiumisation wave
- Strong earnings growth (+62% YoY) with operating leverage visible
- Conservative balance sheet (D/E 0.21)

**Risks**
- Valuation leaves no margin of safety — P/E 90 / FwdPE 57 assumes flawless execution
- Low-margin IMFL segment still anchors volumes; any excise/regulatory shock hits the whole stack
- Token dividend (yield ~0.1%) means no income cushion if the thesis de-rates
- Geopolitical/macro risk (oil, rates) can compress consumer discretionary multiples even if fundamentals hold

---

## Verdict (One-Liner)

Radico Khaitan is **a high-quality premiumisation compounder priced for near-perfection** — the growth is real (vodka volumes, +62% earnings), but the stock is discounting a lot of the future already. A pullback toward the ₹3,000–3,500 zone would be the risk-reward window; at ₹4,089 near all-time highs, the setup favours momentum traders over value buyers.
